board: ESP32-C3 board with an ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module (user-supplied)

chip.features: Wi-Fi, BT 5 LE, single core, 160 MHz, embedded 4 MB flash (XMC)

preservation.transport: on-board CP2102N USB-to-UART bridge, 921600 baud, esptool stub
preservation.original_boot_log: not captured before the receiver install; restoring the image reproduces it

receiver_install.extra_config: CONFIG_ESP32C3_REV_MIN_2=y (ESP-IDF defaults to v0.3; v0.2 is a stock option)
receiver_install.write: esptool write-flash at 921600, every region hash-verified

first_contact.link: UART0 via the CP2102N at 2000000 baud
first_contact.CAPS: CAPS SPEC SPECN SPECCAPS SPECSTAT DCT UARTBAUD RXLIMITS SERIALLEASE DUALSERIAL TUNEEXT LPFANA GAIN HWAGC IQ8

not_yet_shown: No RF capture has been taken. Snapshots are 80 MS/s only (16380 samples = 204.75 us), so the 16 MS/s BLE decoder and tools/esp_sdr_capture.py (which expects INFO 'ESP32SDR') need adapting before reception claims.
private: Flash images and device identifiers stay under ignored backups/esp32c3/
